rationale.A: Mostly paths via Perkkaa and Munkkiniemi, but ~1.6 km on the Paciuksenkatu-side track, 50 m on Runeberginkatu, 5 unsignalised crossings; 8 lights
rationale.B: Like A but more roadside riding (Itsehallintotie, Tarvaspääntie) and 70 m on tram-railed Eino Leinon katu; 8 lights
rationale.C: Munkkiniemi, Central Park, Olympic area and Töölönlahti; no mixed traffic; ~1.9 km roadside; 2 lights; +2 min
rationale.D: Same as C but starts through quiet Pellavaniemi, avoiding the Itsehallintotie-side track; 2 lights
rationale.E: Via Perkkaa, Pitäjänmäki and Tilkka to Central Park; almost nothing beside major roads; 3 lights; +3 min
rationale.F: Like C but ends via Eläintarha and Kaisaniemi; 1 light; +5 min
rationale.G: Long tracks beside Turuntie (60 km/h) and Vihdintie, unsignalised Turuntie crossings, 250 m on Valimotie; +9 min
rationale.H: Otaniemi detour with long Kuusisaarentie/Paciuksenkatu-side tracks and several unsignalised crossings; +18 min

notes: A is already fairly calm, so the calm pick is borderline: E moves ~2.5 km (~23%) of arterial-side riding onto paths for +3 min. C saves 6 lights for +2 min. C and D share ~77% (they differ over the first 2 km), so I kept them apart.
